data.name: TCGA Kidney Cancers
data.abstract: The TCGA Kidney Cancers Dataset is a bulk RNA-seq dataset that contains transcriptome profiles of patients diagnosed with three different subtypes of kidney cancers. This dataset can be used to make predictions about the specific subtype of kidney cancers given the normalized transcriptome profile data, as well as providing a hands-on experience on large and sparse genomic information.

intro_paper.title: The Cancer Genome Atlas Pan-Cancer analysis project
intro_paper.authors: J. Weinstein, E. Collisson, G. Mills, K. Shaw, B. Ozenberger, K. Ellrott, I. Shmulevich, C. Sander, Joshua M. Stuart

additional_info.purpose: To better understand the relationship between human genome and cancers
additional_info.instances_represent:
- Bulk transcriptome profiles
- Kidney cancer patients
- Worldwide population
additional_info.recommended_data_splits: Cross validation or a fixed train-test split could be used.
additional_info.sensitive_data: This dataset contains the variables age, race, and ethnicity.
additional_info.variable_info: Bulk RNA-Seq normalized using FPKM (fragments per kilo million) method
